newsitem.title: USA: Mercury Finance faces another suit.
newsitem.headline: Mercury Finance faces another suit.

text.p: Another shareholder suit seeking class action status has been filed against Mercury Finance Co, lawyers for the plaintiffs said Monday.

The complaint, filed in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Illinois, alleges that for four fiscal years the company's financial statements overstated the profitability and performance of the company, said plaintiffs' lawyer Gary Cantor of the firm Berger & Montague, in a telephone interview.
Mercury Finance said last week it had to restate its earnings for the past four years because of accounting irregularities.
Kate Connelly of The Dilenschneider Group, a public relations firm representing Mercury Finance, said she had no knowledge of the suit, and no one from the company was available for comment.
The suit seeks to recover damages on behalf of purchasers of Mercury Finance Co from January 31, 1994 through January 28, 1997, Cantor said.
The law firm of Miller Faucher Chertow Cafferty and Wexler is also representing the plaintiffs.
